resources.string: Could not connect to the PC. Check that its streaming host is running, both devices can reach each other, and the PC firewall allows streaming. Then try again.
The host denied this request. In your host’s settings or web UI, enable this device and allow viewing or launching apps.
The host could not start this stream (error %1$d). Check the host’s status in its web UI, refresh the app list and try again.
The PC returned an invalid server version. Update or restart the host and try again.
This PC has no virtual display, so it streams its own screen.
This device is no longer paired. Return to the PC list and pair it again.
This app is no longer in the PC’s library. Refresh the app list and choose another app.
This session is no longer available. Refresh the app list and choose a session.
The PC does not support resolutions above 4K. Choose 4K or lower in Stream settings.
Resolutions above 4K need HEVC or AV1 support on this device. Choose a lower resolution or another codec.
Update GeForce Experience on the PC to stream 4K. This stream is 1080p.
The PC and this device share no HDR codec, so the stream is in SDR.
PyroWave HDR is unavailable on this device (%1$s), so HDR uses another codec.
Could not resume the session. Check the app on the PC and try again.
Another device owns this session. End it on that device or on the PC, then try again.
The app is minimized. Restore it on the PC, or quit the session and start it again.
Could not quit the previous session. End it on the PC and try again.
Could not start the app. Check that it opens on the PC, then try again.
This device cannot list apps. Allow application listing for this device in your host’s settings or web UI. The library refreshes automatically.
Could not load the PC’s apps. Check the host and this device’s application-list permission in its settings or web UI. Retrying automatically.
No apps are available. Add apps to the host library and check this device’s application-list permission in your host’s settings or web UI.
Save stream settings?
Your changes to this PC’s stream settings have not been saved. A display mode confirmed in its own dialog is saved separately.
Discard changes
This replaces resolution, frame rate, bitrate, frame pacing, upscaling, VRR and performance settings with this preset’s values. Codec and HDR choices stay as they are.
PIN rejected. Generate a new one-time PIN in your host’s web UI and check the passphrase.
